items.actClause: AN ACT in relation to authorizing the town of Clifton Park in the county of Saratoga, to discontinue the use of certain park land and lease such land for use of a wireless communications facility
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S7427

TITLE OF BILL:
An act in relation to authorizing the town of Clifton Park in the
county of Saratoga, to discontinue the use of certain park land and
lease such land for use of a wireless communications facility

PURPOSE:
The town of Clifton Park, located in the county of Saratoga, is hereby
authorized, acting by and through its town board and upon such terms
and conditions as determined by such board, to discontinue the use of
certain municipally owned park land, and to lease at fair market value
to Independent Towers, LLC, for a term not to exceed twenty-five
years, said park land as described in section two of this act for the
purpose of erecting, maintaining and operating a wireless
communications facility.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
Section 1. a. The town of Clifton Park, located in the county of
Saratoga, is hereby authorized, acting by and through its town board
and upon such terms and conditions as determined by such board, to
discontinue the use of certain municipally owned park land, and to
lease at fair market value to Independent Towers, LLC, for a term not
to exceed twenty-five years, said park land as described in section
two of this act for the purpose of erecting, maintaining and operating
a wireless communications facility.  b. All proceeds from such lease
shall be used for capital improvements to existing park and recreation
facilities.
